content:
derek_backend: Hi folks — got my 2025 W-2 and it has two state boxes: CA $48,000 and WA $12,000. I moved from CA to WA in Oct 2025 and filed a change in ADP in Nov. My question: why is CA showing the larger amount? I thought most wages after Oct should be WA.

liz_payroll: Thanks for flagging Derek. Can you DM the W-2 pic? Quick note: Box 15/16 show state wages by the payroll file mapping, which depends on the residency flag and payroll project codes.

derek_backend: DM sent. Also net pay matched expectations so I'm not sure if tax was overwithheld. CA state tax line on the stub is small but it's on the W-2.

marta_hr: I pulled your HR record — ADP address update landed 11/12/2025 but your "tax residency effective" field remained 01/01/2025 (we didn't backdate). That explains why payroll files allocated most Nov wages to CA. Sorry about that.

kevin_tax: For W-2 purposes employers can allocate wages by where work was performed and by residency. If you physically moved in Oct but HR record changed later, wages earned after your move may still be reported to CA. We can issue a W-2c to correct state allocation if appropriate.

liz_payroll: Next steps: (1) We'll reconcile timecards and work location entries for Oct1025 to see which pay periods should be WA; (2) If error, we'll prepare W-2c for CA and WA and reverse state withholding if remittance still recoverable; (3) We'll update your tax residency effective date to 10/15/2025 so future reporting is correct.

derek_backend: If you issue a W-2c does that change my personal filing? I already filed my CA return because I had an estimated liability.

kevin_tax: Good Q. W-2c will adjust the wage/tax boxes — if it reduces CA wages you filed, you may need to file an amended CA return (Form 540X equivalent) or request a refund. We'll provide the W-2c and an internal memo explaining the employer-side correction to attach to your amendment. If CA refund is involved we can assist with letters to the Franchise Tax Board.

liz_payroll: Ticket PAY-ADJ-9124 created. Target: reconcile by 2026-02-10 and, if needed, submit W-2c by 2026-02-17. If state remittance already processed and we can't recover, we'll advise on employee filing steps and consider reimbursement for any out-of-pocket shortfall.

marta_hr: I'll also add a step to the relocation checklist: when address change is submitted, HR must set the tax residency effective date to the employee's move date if provided.

derek_backend: Thanks. One more thing: my SEIU 401(k) deferrals appear correctly but did that affect state wages?

kevin_tax: 401(k) deferrals reduce taxable wages for federal and most state wages per plan rules. We'll confirm deferral treatment in the reconciliation.

payroll-bot: PAY-ADJ-9124 created and assigned to liz_payroll. Estimated resolution: 2026-02-17.
